name: @playform/hook-dsh-workspace-journal
description: The workspace-journal hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that is the workspace's EVIDENCE record - the undo, the recovery checkpoints, and the crash recovery (the JOURNAL role of the workspace family's invisible flow: ... -> the merge commits (through Factory.Write) -> the journal records -> the audit lines -> the live view presents). The journal holds the PER-BATCH RECORDS and the REVERT DATA: a batch (the ordered set of per-file writes plus the journal, WORKSPACE-FAMILY-V4-1.md section 3.8) is journaled BEFORE its writes land - the merge calls workspaceJournal.open(batchId, operation, entries) with the per-file pre-images (content + version captured before the write), the journal stores them in its own KV storage domain named workspace_journal, and only then does the merge proceed; workspaceJournal.seal(batchId, 'verified') closes the batch. The HONEST ALL-OR-NOTHING (V4-1 section 6, check 5): a crash between the commit and the seal is never an invisible intermediate state - at the next boot the journal finds the batch still 'applying', marks it 'recovery-required' with the identity, and reports it; the recovery checkpoints (the fs/observed listener records the per-file write progress against the open batch) show how far the crash got. workspaceJournal.revert(batchId) replays the pre-images backward through the factory's version-fenced write executor (replaceIfVersion against the observed current version; a fence mismatch is a typed conflict, never a silent overwrite); an absent pre-image file is removed. The conversation never sees any of it until an event surfaces it (the visibility rule). The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/JOURNAL.md + Documentation/Plans/WORKSPACE-FAMILY-V4-1.md sections 3.7-3.8 + Documentation/Plans/Batch-Edit-Tool/FORMS-AND-GOVERNANCE-LAYERS.md (the rollback layer, the batch_edit_journal domain pattern).
